member.name: T:Pxl.Ui.CSharp.SkyGradient
member.summary:
The sky as a gradient with THREE horizon colours instead of one: warm where the sun stands, cool where the moon stands, and a far colour everywhere else. Each pixel mixes toward a body's colour by its horizontal distance to it.
This is what makes a sunset look like a sunset. A single horizon colour gives an even orange wash across the whole sky; the pull gives a warm COLUMN of light with cool sky beside it - and that contrast is the entire effect.
